title: Stick Soccer Duel
description: Dash across a lively pitch in snappy arcade soccer clashes—dribble past defenders, hammer curving power shots, and bury goals top-corner.
controls: Move your striker with on-screen controls and tap shoot/jump buttons to outscore your rival.

zh-CN.title: 棒棒足球
zh-CN.description: 畅快街机绿茵竞技棒棒足球：灵巧盘带过人、大力抽射轰出世界波，一分钟爽踢一局随时开赛！
zh-CN.controls: 使用屏幕方向与射门按钮控球突破，精准起脚攻破对手球门赢下比赛。
